excerpt: Kate Gannon | Professor of Practice, Communication | Kate Gannon is a professor of practice in the Communication Department at The University of Texas at El Paso, teaching multimedia journalism writing and production, data journalism, new media tools and social engagement. As Director of Borderzine, she manages the Borderzine.com website and social media channels as a showcase and competitive training tool for student journalists from the U.S.-Mexico borderland to meet the needs of a media industry seeking a well-prepared and diverse applicant pool.
